dimensions.assessment: Affects veterans appealing certain claims to the Board of Veterans' Appeals and those receiving specific pensions.
dimensions.evidence: In an appeal of a decision under section 5108 of this title regarding a supplemental claim... the Board may not deny relief

dimensions.assessment: Modifies evidentiary rules and review standards for specific veteran claim types without altering broad benefit structures.
dimensions.evidence: the evidentiary record before the Board shall be limited to the evidence previously considered by the Board in such case.

dimensions.assessment: No significant spending or revenue changes are explicitly detailed beyond extending a pension payment limit timeframe.
dimensions.evidence: Section 5503(d)(7) of title 38, United States Code, is amended by striking 'November 30, 2031' and inserting 'January 30, 2035'.

dimensions.assessment: Amends title 38 of the United States Code regarding Board of Veterans' Appeals jurisdiction and evidentiary rules.
dimensions.evidence: To amend title 38, United States Code, to clarify the jurisdiction and certain rules of evidence of the Board of Veterans' Appeals.

dimensions.assessment: Statutory rule changes are permanent, and the pension limit extension runs through January 2035.

missing_information: Cost estimates or budgetary impact figures are not provided in the source text.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill makes specific rule changes regarding the Board of Veterans' Appeals and extends a pension limitation deadline, resulting in limited administrative and legal shifts.
